description: Read-only GET request to the FinzData REST API (docs: https://finzdata.com/docs) with your key (for example /v1/prices/daily, /v1/futures/daily, /v1/gex/daily, /v1/cot, /v1/pulse/{name}, /v1/model/latest). Optionally save the result into your workspace with save_to.
name: finzdata_get
title: Get FinzData API data
